findings.summary: M18.283 set the 8-minute idle limit (TEST_IDLE_MS) without recording its margin against the longest silent gap in a green run. Three kinds of gap print nothing: one file's run (the node project uses one worker on Windows, under coverage), the pause between the node and browser groups, and the v8 coverage report after the last 'end' line. Only one green run with the watchdog exists (42171158023). The step fails loudly with a report, so a spurious failure would be diagnosable, not hidden. The watchdog detects stalls robustly and does not weaken a gate.
findings.evidence: precommit.mjs:57 TEST_IDLE_MS = 8 * 60_000. progress-reporter.mjs prints only module queued/start/end lines. M18.283's progress entry measures no gap. Earlier macOS verify runs took 17.8-20 min under capacity contention (progress.md, 2026-11-04 entries).
findings.failure_scenario: On a contended macOS or Windows runner, the coverage remap or one slow node file takes more than 8 min. Main goes red with an ::error:: that names no file in flight, and a stream reads it as a fourth stall.

findings.summary: M18.281's settle cannot pass a real build failure today. The root build is exactly `turbo run build`. TURBO_ALL_SUCCESSFUL needs 'N successful, N total' at the start of a line, and turbo's stream UI prefixes task output, so no task can forge the summary. A failure before the summary keeps its status. But this rests on package.json's build script, and no test pins it. If the script gained a step after turbo ('turbo run build && node x'), that step would be killed after 60 s and the build would pass.
findings.evidence: package.json:14 "build": "turbo run build". build-settle.test.mjs never reads package.json. In lib.mjs, settleWatch resolves status 0 after settle.ms.
findings.failure_scenario: A later row appends a post-build check to the root build script. On a slow runner the check is still running 60 s after turbo's summary, so it is killed, and the ladder reports the build green with only a ::warning::.

questions.gateHonesty: No gate was weakened. M18.278 does not loosen its gate. Load only adds time, so each side's fastest read is its least noisy estimate. The bound is unchanged, and the recorded mutants read 12.2 and 10.0 against 3. M18.281 cannot pass a failed build (F5 is only latent). M18.283 turns a silent timeout into an earlier failure and never passes a stalled run (F4 is a spurious-failure risk only). Mutant spot-checks by reading: (1) if settleWatch resolved with the child's status, build-settle's stuck case would fail; (2) if idleWatch dropped `fired`, the r1 F3 case would fail; (3) if cli-mcp's Windows install got --with-deps back, ci-workflow.test's [1,1,2] count would fail.
